prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified.  Clothes should use medieval simple round-neck or tie-neck wool cuts, NOT modern lapels, tailored suit coats or collared shirts. THREE rows TWO columns. TOP KARE adult mother and returning resident, chestnut hair pinned under desaturated red kerchief, brown long dress, faded blue-grey apron, small closed household cloth bundle at waist. MIDDLE ODO her adult husband and ordinary fisherman, middle-aged brown hair with grey short beard, plain moss-grey round-neck tunic, weathered tan sleeveless vest, dark trousers and simple work boots, short coil of ordinary rope held low. BOTTOM ELE their clearly ADULT daughter, young adult with dark braid, ochre wool tunic over dark brown skirt, modest pale shoulder shawl, small personal closed bag at hip, empty hands and independent attentive posture. Three autonomous people, not a family consent scene, no boat voyage, home awarded, housing contract, work conscription or forgiveness. No military uniforms or official NPC likeness.
